description: This file contains the PageModel for the Basket Index page in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages application. It manages basket operations such as retrieving the basket, adding items, and updating quantities, including handling user identification via cookies and user identity.

classes.name: IndexModel
classes.description: Razor Pages PageModel for the Basket Index page, handling basket display and updates.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch or create the basket for the user.

methods.name: OnPost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new item to the basket.

methods.name: OnPostUpdate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update quantities of items in the basket.

methods.name: GetOrSetBasketCookieAndUserName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a unique identifier for the user's basket, using cookies or user identity.

search-terms: Get or create basket user identifier
